title: Velvety Rich Slovakian Meat Dumplings
description: Indulgent Slovakian dish featuring fermented and aerated meat dumplings made with vegetable shortening and rest-meat, suitable for a satvik-friendly diet. This dish is a hearty and comforting meal.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the chilled vegetable shortening and ground rest-meat, mixing until just combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, and black pepper.
Add the dry ingredients to the meat mixture and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Gradually add the water to the dough, mixing until the dough comes together in a ball.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it ferment in a warm place for 2 hours.
After fermentation, punch down the dough and divide it into small balls.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle and place a tablespoon of nutritional yeast in the center.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and gently add the dumplings to the pot.
Cook the dumplings for 10-15 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
